ShippingPage.title: Shipping
ShippingPage.intro: We deliver to all 48 wilayas of Algeria. Delays and costs depend on the zone.
ShippingPage.zone1: Zone 1 (Algiers and nearby) — 1 to 2 business days
ShippingPage.costBody: Shipping fees are calculated automatically at checkout based on your wilaya.
ShippingPage.trackingBody: A tracking code is emailed when your order ships. You can also see all your orders from your account.

ReturnsPage.title: Returns
ReturnsPage.intro: You have 14 days from receipt to return an item that doesn't suit you.
ReturnsPage.cond1: The item must be new, unworn, with original tags.
ReturnsPage.cond3: Sale items and accessories in direct contact (underwear, jewellery) are non-returnable.
ReturnsPage.howBody: Contact customer service with your order number. We arrange the return and the refund within 7 days of receipt.

SizeGuidePage.title: Size guide
SizeGuidePage.intro: Find the size that fits you. Measurements in centimetres.
SizeGuidePage.how1: Chest: tape under the arms at the widest point.
SizeGuidePage.how2: Waist: at the narrowest point, just above the navel.
SizeGuidePage.how3: Hip: at the widest point, usually 20 cm below the waist.
SizeGuidePage.footnote: Tip: measure a garment that fits you well and compare with the chart.

FaqPage.title: Frequently asked questions
FaqPage.intro: Everything you need to know to shop on OSCAR Najar.
FaqPage.q1: How do I place an order?
FaqPage.a1: Add items to your cart, go to the cart, fill in your address and pick a payment method (CIB, Baridimob, or cash on delivery).
FaqPage.q2: What payment methods do you accept?
FaqPage.a2: CIB, Baridimob, and cash on delivery across all of Algeria.
FaqPage.a3: 1 to 7 business days depending on your wilaya. See the Shipping page for details.
FaqPage.q4: How do I return an item?
FaqPage.a4: You have 14 days after receipt. See the Returns page for the conditions.
FaqPage.a5: Yes. We never store your payment data and we serve every page over HTTPS.

AboutPage.title: About OSCAR Najar
AboutPage.intro: Elegant fashion at the heart of Algeria.
AboutPage.storyBody: OSCAR Najar was born from the belief that Algerian elegance deserves a modern showcase. We work with local artisans to ship collections that respect both tradition and the contemporary rhythm.
AboutPage.v1: Quality — every piece is checked before shipping.
AboutPage.v2: Closeness — customer service in French and Arabic.
AboutPage.v3: Reach — delivery to all 48 wilayas, cash on delivery available.
